current.description: Unit of every amp, amp2, long_amp and rheobase value.

time.description: Unit of every ton, tmid, tmid2 and toff value.

protocols.description: Keyed by protocol (eCode) name as written in the NWB file, e.g. "IDrest", "sAHP", "GenericStep". Current-clamp protocols only; voltage-clamp, conductance-clamp and extracellular stimuli are not included.

rheobase.description: Keyed by step protocol name as in protocols: the smallest amp whose sweep fires at least one spike, from that protocol's sweeps alone (bluepyefe 'absolute' strategy, read with the stored timing). null if no sweep fires; 0 or below if a sweep fires without current injected.

Amplitudes.description: Distinct values relative to the holding current, across all sweeps and repetitions; sorted, rounded to 0.001 nA. Lists are not paired sweep by sweep.

Times.description: Distinct times from the start of the sweep, detected per sweep; sorted, rounded to 0.01 ms, values within 2 ms counted once. Several values mean the protocol's sweeps differ.
